target = bytes.fromhex("36ed5a2cd45d97b135d340ed6ea9b061f773e568e776")

# For each position i:
#   char = input[i]
#   if (char ^ c) == target[i]: 
#       c = c + char + i

# To reverse: char = target[i] ^ c, then update c
